about.title: What about me?
about.p1: My name is Mateo G. Fontana Dalmasso and I'm a designer with years of experience creating digital experiences, static graphic design, multimedia projects with AI, Vibe Coding and Vibe Design to connect brands with their audiences.
about.p2: I'm a deeply interdisciplinary person. My curiosity and outlook on life have led me to several fields that complement one another. That's helped me develop a distinctive point of view—knowing that the same task or problem can be seen at once from different angles to shape or design a truly creative, effective idea to solve it.
about.p3: I like to research AI to understand how to get the most out of it for what I need, applying Vibe Coding and Vibe Design with discernment, precision and a professional approach.
about.p4: With years of experience in Graphic Design, UX/UI, Vibe Coding and Vibe Design, I always aim to turn ideas into reality in a clear, effective way, putting users first and with the right tone for communication.

1.title: 1190 Sports
1.subtitle: Deck design, Multi-cut system, social media, OTT and corporate presentations
1.description: Full decks, multi-cut system, social and YouTube assets, AFA Play OTT key visuals and institutional presentations for 1190 Sports.
1.fullDescription:
Project focused on creating full decks for 1190 Sports: visual research, photo selection, image treatment and high-impact compositions for commercial presentations (PowerPoint) related to image rights and sponsorships in Argentina, Peru and Brazil.

Implementation of the multi-cut system to design multiple campaign pieces simultaneously across resolutions. Applied to content such as Franco Mastantuono and Superclásico to ensure visual consistency across desktop, mobile, banners and thumbnails. Result: reduced production time and stronger brand consistency across channels.

Development of promotional pieces for social media and YouTube with a focus on CTR and recall (thumbnails, banners, posters), optimizing production through a multi-cut system. Creation of key visuals for AFA Play OTT campaigns with featured players, versions for home hero, social push and seasonal promotional material.

Design of institutional presentations: who we are, portfolio, partners and clients, with visual styles, grid and reusable components for commercial proposals.

2.title: Novogas
2.subtitle: CX & UX/UI, Web App and Mobile App for gas-tech ecosystem
2.description: UX/UI design for digital platform and mobile app: login, navigation, operational panels, interactive map, analytics and real-time consumption monitoring.
2.fullDescription:
UX/UI project for Novogas covering login, navigation, operational panels and mobile experience. User flows, interface components and visual guidelines to improve operational clarity.

Design of the home and full web app layout: registration views, login, interactive map, analytics, forms and operational states in dark/light mode for distribution companies (cylinder monitoring, status by zone and key metrics).

Design of mobile app for end users with real-time cylinder status monitoring, light and dark mode views, state components, consumption indicators and refill/order actions.
